title: Private playable/safe-empty counts are trusted without reconciliation to actual round cards
trigger: The exact author fake result has one pair_private round. Change its card to null and remove its private_history record, but retain summary private_playable=1/private_safe_empty=0. Existing runPreflight accepts it and returns PLANNED_SIMULATION_ONLY.
counterexample_scope: Exact consumer helper + existing author finite fake fixture only; no actual r4 preflight or product defect demonstrated.
current_native_API_scope: Current preflightTopics source correctly derives both counters from history. Finding is a missing independent measurement oracle, not evidence current native planner misreports.
effect: A mismatched or regressed summary can convert a raw safe-empty opportunity into reported positive private coverage. Sum-to-opportunities alone does not establish playable/private-safe-empty parity.
minimal_fix: Require safe integer nonnegative opportunity/playable/empty counters and independently derive playable and safe-empty counts from history.rounds filtered by pair_private and card presence; require exact equality to each counter before choosing status/output. Preserve legitimate safe-empty/refusal semantics and no retry. Add positive empty/playable plus mismatched/null-card/non-null-card/negative-counter controls in an additive revision.
